level_1: Obtains basic pediatric dermatologic history and physical exam
Independently manages pediatric patients with common dermatologic conditions

Independently evaluates pediatric patients with complex dermatologic conditions

Independently manages pediatric patients with complex dermatologic conditions and/or comorbidities
level_4: Manages pediatric patients with common dermatologic conditions, with assistance
Independently evaluates and manages pediatric patients with rare, atypical, or refractory dermatologic conditions

level_1: Performs pre- and post- operative assessment for common, office-based procedures on pediatric patients, with guidance
Identifies procedural complications, with assistance
Independently performs a range of procedures on pediatric patients with complex conditions using patient comfort strategies
level_2: Identifies indications and contraindications for procedures in pediatric patients

level_3: Demonstrates awareness of potential procedural complications
Independently performs procedures on pediatric patients with routine conditions using patient comfort strategies
Provides expert advice and consultation to other care practitioners for complex procedural management (surgical or laser) of pediatric patients with various dermatologic conditions
level_4: Performs pre-operative assessment for diagnostic and therapeutic (excisions, laser) procedures on pediatric patients, including alternatives and/or deferral of procedural approaches
Manages procedural complications, with guidance
Helps to develop improved procedure methodologies and management for complications of procedures
level_5: Performs procedures on pediatric patients using patient comfort strategies, with assistance

Independently performs pre-operative assessment and counseling of risk for diagnostic and therapeutic (excisions, laser) procedures and deciding the most appropriate setting for the procedure (e.g., office versus ambulatory surgery center) based on complexity of the planned procedures(s)

level_1: Understands the indications, and selects and performs in-office tests, with assistance
Interprets laboratory, imaging, and other diagnostic tests for complex or rare presentations, with guidance
level_2: Selects laboratory, imaging, and other diagnostic tests for common presentations
Independently interprets laboratory, imaging, and other diagnostic tests for complex or rare presentations
level_3: Independently selects and performs in-office tests; interprets in-office diagnostic tests, with assistance

level_4: Independently interprets laboratory, imaging, and other diagnostic tests for common presentations

level_5: Independently selects, performs, and interprets a full spectrum of in-office tests

level_1: Develops a differential diagnosis for common presentations of pediatric conditions, with guidance
level_2: Independently develops a differential diagnosis for common presentations of pediatric conditions
level_3: Develops a prioritized differential diagnosis for complex presentations of pediatric conditions and recognizes nuances in clinical and diagnostic features
level_4: Pursues and synthesizes additional information to reach high-probability diagnoses with continuous re-appraisal
level_5: Seeks and integrates additional data and educates others to minimize clinical reasoning errors

level_1: Identifies patients who are candidates for topical and systemic therapy
Selects appropriate laboratory monitoring for systemic treatments for pediatric patients, with guidance
Independently selects from among all available therapeutic modalities for common and uncommon skin disorders based on patient age and underlying medical conditions
level_2: Identifies available treatment options for common skin disorders based on patient age and underlying medical conditions

Independently orders appropriate laboratory monitoring and manages adverse effects of therapeutics
level_3: Identifies therapeutic agents that require laboratory monitoring

Independently manages rare and complex diseases based on emerging evidence
level_4: Provides appropriate counseling regarding adverse effects and reasonable risks
Selects appropriate laboratory monitoring for pediatric patients and manages adverse effects, with guidance
Evaluates the application of novel and emerging therapeutic modalities or unique applications of existing drugs based on patient age and underlying medical conditions
level_5: Selects treatment options for common skin disorders, with guidance, based on patient age and underlying medical conditions
Consistently identifies refractory disease and independently escalates therapy as necessary
Develops systems for safety monitoring

level_1: Describes fundamental cutaneous anatomy and physiology of neonatal, pediatric, and adolescent skin
Demonstrates knowledge of the clinical features, associations, treatments, and expected course of uncommon and complex pediatric dermatologic disorders
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of the clinical features of common pediatric dermatologic disorders
Synthesizes knowledge of pathophysiology of pediatric skin disorders and applies this knowledge to management and counseling

level_4: Demonstrates knowledge of the clinical features, associations, treatments, and expected course of common pediatric dermatologic disorders
Teaches emerging concepts in cutaneous pathophysiology as it applies to the pediatric patient
level_5: Demonstrates knowledge of the pathophysiology of complex pediatric skin disorders

Integrates visual diagnostic tools (e.g., dermoscopy) for basic diagnoses
level_2: Describes morphology with fluency
Identifies variable presentations of uncommon and rare pediatric skin disease
level_3: Identifies uncommon pediatric skin diseases with characteristic findings
Integrates visual diagnostic tools for a wide range of diagnoses of the skin, hair, and nails

Mentors others in recognizing pediatric skin disease, including the use of visual diagnostic tools
level_5: Identifies variable presentations of common pediatric skin disease

Discloses patient safety events to patients and their families (simulated or actual) with guidance from mentor
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of how to report patient safety events
Participates in analysis of safety events (simulated or actual)
Demonstrates understanding of the skills required to identify, develop, implement, and analyze a quality improvement project
level_3: Demonstrates knowledge of basic quality improvement methodologies and metrics
Participates in disclosure of patient safety events to patients and their families (simulated or actual)

level_4: Identifies system factors that lead to safety events
Participates in local quality improvement initiatives
Independently discloses patient safety events to patients and their families (simulated or actual)

Conducts analysis of safety events and offers error prevention strategies (simulated or actual)

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of care coordination

Advocates for safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs within and across health care delivery systems, including outpatient settings

Performs safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs in complex clinical situations

level_4: Coordinates care of patients in routine clinical situations effectively using the roles of interprofessional team members

level_5: Performs safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs in routine clinical situations
Leads effective coordination of patient- centered care among different disciplines and specialties

subcompetencies.name: Physician Role in Health Care Systems

level_1: Identifies key components of the complex health care delivery system
Engages with patients in shared decision-making, informed by each patient’s payment models
level_2: Describes basic health payment systems and practice models
Modifies individual practice to optimize the effects on the broader health care delivery system
level_3: Describes how components of a complex health care delivery system are interrelated, and how this impacts patient care
Advocates for patient care needs within the limitations of each patient’s payment model
level_4: Delivers care with consideration of each patient’s payment model
Advocates for or leads systems change that enhances high-value, efficient, and effective patient care
level_5: Identifies various components of the complex health care delivery system and their role in efficient and effective patient care

level_1: Demonstrates how to access and use available evidence and incorporate patients’ and patients’ families’ preferences and values to the care of a routine patient
level_2: Articulates clinical questions and elicits the patient’s and patient’s family’s preferences and values to guide evidence- based care
level_3: Locates and applies the best available evidence, integrated with the patient’s and patient’s family’s preference, to the care of complex patients
level_4: Critically appraises and applies evidence, even in the face of uncertainty and conflicting evidence, to guide care tailored to the individual patient
level_5: Coaches others to critically appraise and apply evidence for complex patients, and/or participates in the development of guidelines

subcompetencies.name: Reflective Practice and Commitment to Personal Growth

level_1: Accepts responsibility for personal and professional development by establishing goals
Creates a learning plan in response to feedback
level_2: Acknowledges limits and gaps between expectations and performance; demonstrates self- awareness

level_4: Analyzes the factors that contribute to limits and gaps in performance; demonstrates appropriate help-seeking behaviors
Models adaptability and self-reflection and coaches others to seek feedback and performance data
level_5: Occasionally seeks feedback and performance data and responds with adaptability and self-reflection
Mentors others on the design and implementation of learning plans

level_1: Identifies areas worthy of scholarly investigation, with supervision
level_2: Designs a scholarly activity with a mentor(s)
level_3: Engages in scholarly work, incorporates feedback, and participates in critical appraisal and analysis of project data
level_4: Produces scholarly work suitable for dissemination as an abstract or presentation
level_5: Disseminates independent scholarly work that generates new medical knowledge, educational programs, or process improvement

level_1: Identifies and describes potential triggers for professionalism lapses

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of medical ethical principles

level_3: Analyzes complex situations using ethical principles
level_4: Recognizes and uses appropriate resources for managing and resolving ethical dilemmas as needed
level_5: Identifies and seeks to address system-level factors that induce or exacerbate ethical problems or impede their resolution

level_1: Responds promptly to requests or reminders to complete tasks

level_1: Recognizes the status of personal and professional well-being, when prompted

level_2: Recognizes personal and professional limits, when prompted

subcompetencies.name: Patient and Family Education and Counseling

level_1: Respectfully requests and responds to a consultation request

level_1: Accurately records information in the electronic health record (EHR) in a timely manner

level_5: Concisely reports diagnostic and therapeutic reasoning in the EHR, using objective and professional language
